changelog:
Fixed the settings crash caused by the packaged host missing Compose awaitPointerEvent$default.
Call the real pointer-event method with the explicit native Main pass; preserve TV confirm cancellation and touch behavior.
Added a final plugin-versus-published-host DEX definition gate instead of trusting unshrunk JVM dependency classes.
Kept the existing dialog, saved-choice, lifecycle and unsupported-feature protections unchanged.
Automated off-device linkage and input checks are not a physical-device retest.
message: Packaged-host Compose pointer ABI crash fix
